regions.label: Jump to the start
regions.note: jmp 056Fh: straight over his data block to the first instruction.

regions.label: Stack and scratch space
regions.note: A block of zeros. The program points its own stack at 0500h inside it.

regions.label: Variables
regions.note: Picture pointer, buffer segment, layer size and strip sizes for the plane copy.

regions.label: Spiral order table
regions.note: 40 screen positions, typed in by hand, that the spiral effect stamps in turn, from the middle out.

regions.label: The show
regions.note: Mode 0Dh, then each picture with its effect and a 64-refresh pause, then the key wait and the sign-off.

regions.label: Sign-off text
regions.note: "YASSER DOT DESIGN." and "<c>1993 YASSER MOHAMED ALI", printed with INT 21h AH=09h.

regions.label: Page byte
regions.note: The display page the sign-off writes to, then two closing bytes.

regions.label: Effects, decoder, plane copy, refresh wait
regions.note: Five wipe effects, the run-length decoder at 0899h, the plane copy at 0981h and the refresh wait at 0885h.

regions.label: Background tile
regions.note: Packed picture: 612 bytes become 800, four color layers of 200.

regions.label: KEMYAM title
regions.note: Packed picture: 9,930 bytes become 9,920, four color layers of 2,480.

regions.label: Logo and signature
regions.note: The three arcs and the green KemYam signature: 5,272 bytes become 5,264.

regions.label: Blue signature box
regions.note: Shown between the member cards: 9,992 bytes become 9,984.

regions.label: Member card 1
regions.note: YASSER MOHAMED ALI: 5,088 bytes become 9,984, half the size.

regions.label: Member card 2
regions.note: MOHAMED ASAAD FOUDA: 5,088 bytes become 9,984, half the size.

regions.label: Member card 3
regions.note: KHALID ZAKARIA MOUSTAFA: 5,088 bytes become 9,984, half the size.

regions.label: Member card 4
regions.note: HATEM MOHAMED MOUSTAFA: 5,088 bytes become 9,984, half the size.

regions.label: Member card 5
regions.note: EBRAHEM EL-SYED EL-ETR: 5,088 bytes become 9,984, half the size.

routines.name: main
routines.note: His own stack, mode 0Dh, the show, the key wait and the sign-off.

routines.name: wait_retrace
routines.note: Waits CX screen refreshes on bit 3 of port 3DAh, so the show runs at the same speed on every PC.

routines.name: rle_decode
routines.note: Copies bytes; 37h n v means n copies of v; 37h 00 ends the picture.

routines.name: plane_copy
routines.note: Copies one strip into color layers 1, 2, 4 and 8 through the Map Mask register.

lines.note: shl al,1: the next color layer
